site_name: CROWN AND NEW BALTIC, PARK AND BRIDGE AND VICTORIA WHARVES, BOUNDED BY GROVE STREET,  DRAGOON STREET AND EVELYN STREET, OXESTALLS ROAD, LONDON, SE8
description: An application submitted under Section 96a of the Town & Country Planning Act 1990 for a non-material amendment in connection with the planning permission (DC/19/119414) dated 23 January 2019, for the variation of Condition (3) Surrey Canal Park (Waterline Park) Placemaking Strategy and Detailed design of Oxestalls Bridge Underpass Arrival Spacein order to allow:- the phased delivery of the Waterline Way (north) Park and Oxestalls Bridge Underpass Arrival Space, including the provision of temporary landscaping, until after Plot 5 had been constructed at Plots 5/6 Crown, New Baltic Park, Bridge And Victoria Wharves, Bounded By Grove, Dragoon And Evelyn Streets Together With, Oxestalls Road, SE8, Renamed as Deptford Landings - formerly known as Deptford Wharves, then The Timberyard SE8.
